root_cause: Whole-writer stage entry requires a genuine analysis bound to each frozen source, and recovery found no matching artifact. Existing preparation exports only Synthesize requests. Before any generation request, an offline capture must identify the production logical ModelRequest with its actual run-derived seed, SummaryProfile, delivery_policy and frozen Analyze context. Character-fit evaluation is separate from unperformed health/native-token evaluation. The capture cannot freeze or approve a native wire body.

required_change_surface.change: Extend the existing test-only preparation through the production Analyze entry/routing owner, with explicit frozen SummaryProfile, delivery_policy, run ID, run-derived seed and Analyze context. Reuse current normalized/chunked source bindings. For the General route, answer health offline and capture the first logical ModelRequest at generate_with_control; return a typed preparation ModelRuntimeFailure before any dispatch. Preserve writer mode startup guards. For Contract, record the existing deterministic no-model route without fabricating a model request or analysis artifact. No production routing/prompt/admission logic may be copied or changed.

Expose the offline Analyze preparation via the existing source/input/receipt/output validation owner. Share lifecycle and freeze logic with writer preparation; do not copy validators or add a second planning owner.

explicit_non_scope: No production Analyze/writer/Verify behavior, prompt, schema, sampler, seed, caps, model, settings or framing changes.
No server/GPU/tokenizer HTTP or generation. No native stage completion or qualification claim.
No fabricated or rebound analysis, no Analyze bypass, no benchmark facts/DV labels, no new parsing/sampling or page splitting.
No publication into frozen132/141/143 branches, production activation, ready transition or merge.
assumptions_blockers: Direct operator acceptance before code/test edits; independent contract review first.

For the frozen General/None entry, obtain the initial logical Analyze request through the unchanged production owner, or record its exact existing failure. Capture is not live health/native admission proof. Any failure stops this slice; no fallback or wider scope.
Paraphrase and repair requests depend on generated selection/text. They are not frozen by this slice; native wire bodies are neither constructed nor approved.

The subsequent live contract must supply finite budget, per-request/response-dependent approval policy, effective-settings evidence and explicit before-send gates. No live authorization is inferred here.
If archived Analyze source differs, inventory the differences before implementing the recorder; do not label a new projection as prior-request parity.
verification_plan: Reuse current mandatory seven-owner frozen baseline receipt; require current source binding.

Use the real production entry/routing owner and pages::analyze. Capture its actual first logical ModelRequest or exact character-admission error. Do not reconstruct a request builder or profile routing rule in the adapter.

Boundary probes: distinct frozen run IDs must bind the actual generation_seed_for_run output; no TEST_GENERATION_SEED/default. Bind and record SummaryProfile, delivery_policy and context. Changed/missing source/profile/count/run/entry bindings stop; Contract follows the deterministic no-model route.

General capture must answer health offline and label it not_evaluated_offline. Assert native_token_fit remains not_evaluated_offline and wire_bodies_approved=false. The stop is a typed ModelRuntimeFailure, not a panic; assert no returned or persisted AnalyzedDocument.

Preserve complete writer initial requests, probe hashes and existing stage-entry missing-analysis result. Reuse existing writer preparation tests, formatter/lint and required offline gate for any eventual source change.

Negative evidence labels must reject any health=passed, native token fit=passed, wire-approved claim, returned ModelResponse/AnalyzedDocument or hidden real runtime/startup/tokenizer contact from offline preparation. Preserve typed character-fit errors and the no-model Contract control.

implementation_summary: Implemented the accepted recording-only Analyze mode in the existing preparation entry and launcher. It calls the unchanged production Analyze entry, captures the actual logical request with a typed stop, records admission levels, and prevents persisted analysis in an in-memory database. Shared source/freeze/output owners are reused; historical writer mode retains its startup guard.
